responsibility: Implements the executable C-side logic of the Nios II GCC backend and binds it to GCC’s target hook interface. This file owns target-specific ABI and RTL behavior that is too procedural for nios2.h or nios2.md: frame-layout computation and prologue/varargs handling via machine_function state, argument passing and return-value classification, address legitimization and cost modeling, small-data and section decisions, PIC/TLS and relocation handling, asm operand/address printing, option parsing/override and attribute merging, custom-instruction/FPU builtin type registration and expansion, machine-dependent reorg and label alignment for compact encodings, and register-allocation tuning such as CDX register order. In effect it consumes generic GCC trees/RTL/options and produces Nios II-specific expansion, diagnostics, and hook decisions used by the rest of the port.
same_name_distinction: Among the same-stem Nios II files, this is the executable backend implementation file: it turns the declarations and defaults from nios2.h, the generated option variables from nios2.opt, and the instruction forms named in nios2.md into target-hook code, builtin expansion, option validation/override, frame and calling-sequence logic, address/cost decisions, asm printing, and machine-dependent reorganization.
